parts.text: Beagle bone black preloaded with Ubuntu and Lasersaur app.
Mouns - acrylic, for controller and other electronics.
Angle brackets, black - 28 parts - see Step11
Angle brackets, non-gusseted - 6 parts - see Step12
Angle brackets double, gusseted, 38 of these - see Step13
Angle brackets double, non-gusseted, 7 of these - see Step14
Angle brackets double, gusseted, 7 of these. - see Step15
SEE BELOW FOR DETAILS AND ADDITIONAL PARTS

lines.text_raw: Beagle Bone black preloaded with Ubuntu and laser sore app. The board later gets a dongle for Wi-Fi USB. Board is either bought from Nortd Labs - or instructions for uploading code are at http://www.lasersaur.com/manual/bbb_setup

lines.text_raw: Mounts for various parts. You can see job file (DXF) - MechParts v14.01 (dxf) at http://www.lasersaur.com/manual/rev14.01

lines.text_raw: Gas nozzle - threaded so optics components can be put on it. Thread is defined 1.035"-40, 23 mm deep on the nozzle. Nozzle is found in CAD - FreeCAD has it. See Thor Labs for Lens Tube for corresponding threads.
